subject: third independent verification of the unified-merge chain head (6 C-hex fold, merged-1148 solved 1148 -> unified 1154)
status: all published endpoint numbers, the 9-bucket open demand histogram, and the candidate rankings are reproduced exactly by a third, structurally different method (solved-set-free ledger)

method.name: solved-set-free ledger verification
inputs: research/experiments/n11-s2-5960-ms5-s7-reuse-20261113/output/class-frontier-s5-ranking-after-merged-multiband2-68dhyg-20261115.csv (175 open S5 orbits with per-S5 remaining count and remaining cost at merged-1148)
the 6 marginal C hexes of the cost-70c band as published in the 50-receipt reconciliation audit (independently BigInt-verified there)
method.inputs_not_used: win7-reuse-hits.csv.gz, s5-remaining-after-reuse.csv.gz, s5-s6-remaining-incidences.csv.gz (unavailable in this environment; not needed by the ledger method)
method.incidence_regeneration: children(X) = {canon(X | 1<<m) : 0<=m<=120} intersect manifest, 175*121 = 21175 canon calls; canon = min over the 8 D4 transforms of the 121-bit BigInt mask, bit index 11*b+a, transforms (x,y),(y,10-x),(10-x,10-y),(10-y,x),(10-x,y),(x,10-y),(y,x),(10-y,10-x)
method.key_theorem: every C hex is unsolved at merged-1148, hence h in rem(X) iff h in children(X); the demand (c1,c2,c4 over the 175 open S5) of any unsolved orbit equals the demand over its rem rows; non-C orbits keep unchanged demand unless their serving S5 closes, and a closing S5 remaining orbits are all in C. Therefore new_rem(X) = rem1148(X) - |C intersect children(X)|, unique = 6699 - |C intersect unique|, sum = 528423 - sum(cost(C intersect unique)), and histogram deltas come only from C hexes with c1=0 (open_only).
method.difference_from_prior_verifications: the two published implementations re-run the fold on runpy-reconstructed solved sets; this verification uses only published ledger aggregates plus freshly regenerated incidence, so it is an independent cross-check of the fold arithmetic itself
